SELECT 
  p.category,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_sales,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
  SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_cost_of_sales,
  COUNT(*) AS line_count
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

SELECT 
  p.category,
  SUM(f.gross_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_gross), 0) AS net_sales_value,
  (SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0)) / 
  (SUM(f.gross_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_gross), 0)) * 100 AS gross_cost_pct,
  100 - (SUM(f.standard_cost) - COALESCE(SUM(r.standard_cost_returned), 0)) / 
  (SUM(f.gross_amount) - COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_gross), 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN fact_return_line r ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 6
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 6
  AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
GROUP BY p.category
ORDER BY p.category

WITH sales_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_net_amount,
    SUM(f.gross_amount) AS total_gross_sales,
    SUM(f.standard_cost) AS total_cost_of_sales
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 6
    AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY p.category
),
returns_data AS (
  SELECT 
    p.category,
    SUM(r.refund_net) AS total_refund_net,
    SUM(r.refund_gross) AS total_refund_gross,
    SUM(r.standard_cost_returned) AS total_cost_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_product p ON r.product_key = p.product_key
  JOIN dim_date d ON r.return_date = d.calendar_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' 
    AND d.fiscal_period = 6
    AND p.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
  GROUP BY p.category
)
SELECT 
  s.category,
  s.total_net_amount - COALESCE(r.total_refund_net, 0) AS net_sales,
  ROUND(100 * (1 - (s.total_cost_of_sales - COALESCE(r.total_cost_returned, 0)) / 
    (s.total_gross_sales - COALESCE(r.total_refund_gross, 0))), 2) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM sales_data s
LEFT JOIN returns_data r ON s.category = r.category
ORDER BY s.category
